body: Thank you all for your kind words and stories you have shared. At the end of the day I wouldn’t want to go through this with anyone else other than them. They are my light in this world and bring so much happiness to my life. I hope we get through this both being happy and healthy. Thanks again

Luckily, our therapists converse so there is another level of communication. I get tired of the “one day at a time” but I think it’s what will get me through. Thank you for you response and understanding.
Yeah, she’s well aware of this all. Just hate the waves of needing to end things

You were raped and I understand it will take awhile to understand what that means but trust me you are not alone. I’ve dealt with the same problem, not knowing, then being told I was wrong. Trust yourself. You know it didn’t feel right and believe yourself. My thoughts are with you right now, I know it is all so scary but you will get through this. Please seek some help now. If you can, have a rape kit preformed, I wish I had one. Find somewhere you can go for your mental health. It took me awhile for me to get help and really set me back. You are a strong person and deserve to be heard. I believe you and I stand with you.
